Subject: Quick escalation: NovaSynergy asks for aggressive rate relief (>25%) for hosted API

Priya / Marcus —

Quick context: NovaSynergy (healthcare workflow SaaS) is in the final stages of legal/procurement and wants us to hit a blended consumption rate that implies a ~27% discount vs our published Hosted API list for a 12‑month committed usage. They are pitching a guaranteed ramp (3M tokens/mo by Q3) and are asking for custom SLA language and a limited data‑residency commitment for EU traffic.

Why this matters now: procurement will cut the PO unless we show executive sanction for >20% off and confirm the SLA wording. They are a strategic win for the healthcare vertical and the reference value is high (two other interested prospects in the same group). Ben (me) has locked a verbal agreement on the ramp and timing; procurement attached a draft term sheet and usage snapshot (attached).

Ask: Priya — can you escalate to execs for signoff to approve up to 27% off with the following conditions?
- 12 month minimum committed consumption (monthly minimums defined in the attached win plan)
- Limited custom SLA: 99.5% uptime, standard incident response times, with financial credits capped at 1x monthly committed spend
- No change to data processing terms beyond region routing (we'll use standard DPA with addendum for EU routing)

If it's helpful I can join a quick briefing. Procurement is waiting for an answer by EOD.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: NovaSynergy_WinPlan_Q4.pdf (pdf), NovaSynergy_usage_snapshot_202612.zip (zip)
